title: Harry Reid's special access program request denied by William Lynn

tellings.quote: mean, Harry Reid tried to get a special access program and he failed because Deputy Secretary of Defense William Lynn denied it.

plain: Harry Reid, the US Senate majority leader, is said to have tried in 2009 to get UFO research made into a special access program, a tightly restricted kind of secret Pentagon project, and to have failed. According to the physicist Eric W. Davis, a former Pentagon contractor on UFO studies, the request was turned down by William Lynn, then Deputy Secretary of Defense. If true, even a powerful senator could not get that level of secrecy approved for the work.
